decision: Promote TQP-15, TQP-16, and TQP-17 to qualified for the declared Godot 4.7.1 Windows x86_64 native reference scope.
reason: The retained wave directly exercises world-transvoxel workers, stale generation rejection, atomic render and collision publication, temporal carve and construction ordering, journal replay, truncated-tail recovery, complete-segment corruption rejection, baked-page checksums, compaction, current and legacy migration, and fail-closed snapshot publication.
alternatives: promote procedural compaction despite the native baked-source contract
claim cross-filesystem or network qualification without evidence
evidence: world-transvoxel generated current and legacy persistence fixtures
qualified_scope: native Windows worker scheduling and publication reference
native Windows temporal edit and deterministic restart replay reference
native Windows current and legacy persistence, corruption, compaction, migration, and recovery reference
explicit_non_claims: automatic cleanup of abandoned snapshot staging directories
atomicity guarantees outside the declared Windows reference platform
downstream_impact: TQP-WAVE-01 is complete and TQP-WAVE-02 becomes the active dependency-ordered work set.
